job.title: [Post] ForkPoint is hiring a remote Remote Senior QA Automation Specialist #ForkPoint ... Hybris…

tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris Specialist | Automated Testing, Web Quality & APIs | Java & SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend and e-commerce specialist with 5+ years of enterprise experience across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record in automated testing, building JUnit unit and integration test suites, and validating web storefronts and headless OCC APIs. Experienced in user acceptance testing (UAT), production troubleshooting, code reviews, and Git workflows. Applies AI tools to accelerate testing and analysis to deliver robust enterprise e-commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Remote Senior QA Automation Specialist
cover_en.hook: ForkPoint’s reputation for delivering high-performance e-commerce platforms makes this Remote Senior QA Automation Specialist opening an exceptional match. With over 5 years of hands-on experience developing, integrating, and testing SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep platform knowledge to verify enterprise digital commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Automated & Integration Testing
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain code quality, verify regression paths, and ensure platform stability across complex enterprise deployments.

bullets.label: Hybris Core & Architecture Verification
bullets.text: Holds SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer credentials with comprehensive expertise across Hybris 2105 and 2211, validating core modules including Order Management, Promotions Engine, Cronjobs, and Backoffice.

bullets.label: Web Testing & API Validation
bullets.text: Tested and validated storefront customizations, Responsive Design, and Headless OCC REST web services, pinpointing integration bottlenecks across external ERP, PIM, and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Quality Assurance & UAT Processes
bullets.text: Conducted systematic code reviews, defined functional acceptance criteria, supported user acceptance testing (UAT), and utilized AI tools to accelerate test analysis and verification documentation.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce testing experience can drive quality at ForkPoint.

tailoring.why_company: ForkPoint stands out for its high-caliber digital commerce engineering and dedication to delivering scalable, flawless e-commerce experiences. Having worked extensively with complex SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) architectures at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my deep platform knowledge, automated testing practices, and meticulous focus on software quality to ensure ForkPoint’s enterprise clients receive robust, high-performing implementations.
tailoring.motivation_short: E-commerce quality requires deep platform expertise. With 5+ years engineering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and automating backend and API tests, I am eager to help ForkPoint uphold flawless software quality across complex enterprise implementations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I saw ForkPoint is hiring a Senior QA Automation Specialist. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), automated testing with JUnit, and headless API validation, I would love to connect and discuss how I can support your QA initiatives.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Remote Senior QA Automation Specialist - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Remote Senior QA Automation Specialist position at ForkPoint. With more than five years of enterprise experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development, automated testing using JUnit, and end-to-end API validation at Shell and Rockwell Automation, I offer direct platform insight to drive rigorous quality assurance. I am based in Karlsruhe with full German work authorization and look forward to discussing how I can support your team.
